pontos.d: In the corner of Surfside Dr and Nautilus Ln behind the Crastenburg Key Lento Resort in southern Key Lento on the coast. The hoop is hanging on a pole in a half-court area behind the resort. The basketball is on the ground just outside the three-point line.

In the back courtyard of The Red Lotus store on the south side of Key Lento. The hoop is in the corner next to the opening of the fence into the back. The basketball is on the bricks nearby between a green container and a forklift

In the corner of Surfside Dr and Nautilus Ln behind the Crastenburg Key Lento Resort in southern Key Lento on the coast. The hoop is hanging on a pole in a half-court area behind the resort. The basketball is on the ground just outside the three-point line.
On a basketball court near the beach in eastern Key Lento. The hoop is at the end of the court. The basketball is located on top of the court on the southeastern edge.

In Key Lento at the green-colored house on the corner of Peach Palm Dr across the street from Gambit Bay. The hoop is hanging above the detached garage. The basketball is located on the gravel path to the right side of the garage.

At Jason’s waterfront house in northern Key Lento. The hoop is hanging on the side of the house, above the overhang to the shed. The basketball is located on the ground underneath the pillar next to the entrance to the shed.

On the west coast of Key Lento on the bay in the corner of Sunset Dr. The hoop is hanging from the top of a pole between a patio awning and a staircase. The basketball is located directly under the hoop against the wall.

In the driveway of a flat gray house in northern Key Lento off of Dolphin Dr. The hoop is hanging above the garage door on the wall. The basketball is located underneath the trailer for the Azure Seashark in the driveway.

At a brown house with a large fish hanging over the door on the northeast side of Key Lento on Dolphin Dr. The hoop is hanging from a pole in the corner of the driveway. The basketball is located inside the garage next to a beer case and a trashcan.

At a condominium building on the coast on the corner of Ocean Sound Rd and Dolphin Dr. The hoop is hanging from a pole on the edge of the Ocean Sound Rd entrance. The basketball is located near the corner entrance on the ground floor against the wall.

In the southeastern recreation yard in front of the kitchens of the Hamlet Correctional Institution Maximum Security Prison in northern Hamlet. The hoop is hanging from the western pole at the edge of the court. The basketball is located on the court near the three-point line.

In the southeastern recreation yard in front of the kitchens of the Hamlet Correctional Institution Maximum Security Prison in northern Hamlet. The hoop is hanging from the eastern pole at the edge of the court. The basketball is located on the court near the three-point line.

In the recreation yard in front of the B-wing of the Hamlet Correctional Institution Maximum Security Prison in northern Hamlet. The hoop is hanging from a pole at the edge of the yard. The basketball is located directly under the hoop on the ground.

In the recreation yard in front of the A-wing of the Hamlet Correctional Institution Maximum Security Prison in northern Hamlet. The hoop is hanging from a pole at the edge of the yard. The basketball is located next to the court between two sets of bleachers.
